breaks.quote: For years, that sentence ended every attempt Melina made at getting healthier.
breaks.why: Melina's story was already told whole in the first half, and this section returns to it with new scenes instead of a callback, so the reader meets her story twice.

breaks.quote: Even her nutritionist once told her that if she were really consistent she would see results every week
breaks.why: This is a brand new scene added after the story was finished, which the reader never saw in the first telling.
